art_direction: Native-scale late-1990s military pixel/cel strike aircraft with a broad delta mass, reinforced spine, recessed ordnance bay and restrained carrier-air-wing markings.
camera: Orthographic top-down, nose-left master; runtime headings use the existing support-flight transform.

source.method: Deterministic authored native-resolution pixel/cel construction; no provider render is promoted.

runtime.animation: Three registered bank silhouettes with paired turbine heat and alternating navigation-light holds.

review.notes: The live release and egress passes preserve a clear heavy delta silhouette while the bay, canopy and engine pairs remain distinct from the Rapier fighter.
